prerequisite: C3 exact-head Pre-Unreal + UE4.27.2 core/production-import green and merged to develop.
purpose: Prepare the evidence-driven far-foliage LOD/cull/overdraw pass after C3 without changing density, gameplay ownership, object paths, or story state.
review_inputs: Imported P1C01 foliage mesh inventory and stable material identities.
Per-mesh LOD count, section/material-slot layout, screen-size transitions and existing cull bands.
Near/mid M_ProductionFoliage assignments produced by C3.
M_ProductionFoliageFar no-WPO master created by C2.
Masked foliage overdraw observations on the target 720p Low-Medium profile before any density expansion.

implementation_contract.selection_rule: Bind the far no-WPO parent only where an actual far LOD/material section is verified. Do not blanket-reparent all foliage instances or infer far-LOD eligibility from filenames alone.
preservation: Keep deterministic material instance object paths unchanged.
Keep AlbedoTexture, Color, Roughness and Metallic values unchanged.
Do not increase instance density, spawn counts or gameplay loading.
Do not move quest IDs, save keys, story anchors, collision ownership or LivingWorld ownership.
Keep C2 known-failure guards: do not introduce UMaterialExpressionSimpleGrassWind or UMaterialExpressionDistanceCullFade.

guards: No far-parent promotion without a concrete mesh/LOD evidence row.
No per-actor wind or fade Tick.
No unsupported UE4.27 editor-expression class shortcuts.
C4 does not claim performance acceptance; target-device profiling remains a later gate.
acceptance: Production import succeeds with deterministic material paths intact.
Every C4 far-parent change is backed by a mesh/LOD evidence row.
Near/mid foliage remains on M_ProductionFoliage and verified far slots use M_ProductionFoliageFar.
No PIE/device/visual/performance acceptance is inferred from compile/import proof.
evidence_boundary: Preparation only. Runtime implementation must not start until C3 is exact-head engine-green and merged.
